title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.27100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Realistic market impact is essential for generative limit order book (LOB) models to serve as world models for trading agents. If a simulator misprices this mechanism, agents learn policies that are optimal in the simulator but wrong in the real market. Existing metrics assess generated streams purely through distributional comparison with historical data, leaving counterfactual response to an agent's own orders largely unexplored. Here, we show that market impact emerges naturally in neural LOB generators trained solely for next-token prediction. We inject execution-style metaorders into the generated message flow of five autoregressive models across five NASDAQ stocks and measure the response using estimators from the empirical impact literature, validated on baselines whose physics is known in advance. translated_title: LOB冲击基准测试：生成式限价订单簿模型中涌现的市场冲击
translated_abstract: 真实的市场冲击对于生成式限价订单簿（LOB）模型充当交易智能体的世界模型至关重要。如果模拟器对这一机制的定价有误，智能体将学到在模拟器中最优、但在真实市场中却是错误的策略。现有指标仅通过与历史数据进行分布比较来评估生成的数据流，而对智能体自身订单的反事实响应则基本未被探索。在本研究中，我们证明了市场冲击能够在仅通过下一词元预测训练的神经LOB生成器中自然涌现。我们向五个自回归模型在五只纳斯达克股票上生成的消息流中注入执行风格的元订单，并使用来自实证冲击文献的估计器来测量响应，这些估计器已在物理特性事先可知的基线上得到验证。我们的基准通过三个阶段评估任何消息级生成器：自由生成（对照价格动态检验订单流持续性……
tldr: 该论文提出LOB-Impact基准，首次证明市场冲击现象能够在仅通过下一词元预测训练的神经限价订单簿生成模型中自然涌现，并通过注入元订单与实证冲击估计器为消息级生成器提供了反事实市场冲击的评估框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the LOB-Impact Benchmark, demonstrating that market impact emerges naturally in neural LOB generators trained solely for next-token prediction, and provides a counterfactual evaluation framework for message-level generators by injecting metaorders and measuring responses with empirical impact estimators.
